column1: # The new-config-surface manifest: one row per config surface, used by the
# /update-zskills update-arm nudge to tell a consumer which config keys were
# added SINCE their recorded zskills_version. The update report is the SINGLE
# config-news channel (no SessionStart nags, no per-session reminders).
# Columns (TAB-separated): <dotted key>  <version introduced>  <shipped default>  <where to set>
#   - version introduced: the YYYY.MM.N zskills release the key first shipped
#     in. Use 2026.06.0 for any key older than reliable record-keeping
#     (precision only matters going forward; comparison is NUMERIC dot-segment,
#     never lexical — see the update-arm fence).
#   - shipped default: the built-in default value the key tracks when unset.
#   - where to set: the config block / tier where a consumer sets the key.
# zskills-defaults.json MUST have a row here (anti-drift); total rows >= 20
# (anti-vacuous). Comment lines (leading #) and blank lines are ignored.
# Tab-separated; do NOT convert tabs to spaces.
